André J

Hi Product Hunt.  
  
For the past two years, we’ve been running AI agents against real production cloud infrastructure at CloudGeni. We learned the hard way that getting an agent to work once is only the beginning. Keeping it running, giving it somewhere safe to execute, connecting users’ accounts, getting human approval, and understanding what happened—and what it cost—is where the work adds up.  
  
We kept rebuilding that infrastructure. So we pulled it out and open-sourced it.

That’s Opengeni: agents in your product, infrastructure out of the box.

It gives developers the pieces they need to ship agents, already wired together: [...] 🔄 Sessions that survive errors, with a replayable history so you can reconnect and pick up where you left off.

🖥️ Sandboxes for agents to do the work, with credentials handled and memory built in.

🔌 Your APIs and your users’ apps, connected. Bring an OpenAPI or GraphQL spec, or an MCP server, plus 100+ integrations with built-in OAuth.

✋ Human approvals before risky actions, so people stay in control.

🔍 Visibility into every step, token, and dollar, with built-in dashboards and run traces.

🧩 A workspace for each customer and the freedom to choose your models.

Getting it into your product takes three steps: add your API key on the server, mount a handler using your existing authentication, and show the agent in your app—with your own UI or our React components. [...] Opengeni
